items.source: context - the evaluation context in which the access is being attempted
items.translation: context - 尝试访问时的评估上下文

items.source: target - the target object upon which the index is being accessed
items.translation: target - 正在访问索引的目标对象

items.source: index - the index being accessed
items.translation: index - 正在访问的索引

items.source: An index accessor can specify an array of target classes for which it should be called. See TargetedAccessor for details.
items.translation: 索引访问器可以指定一个目标类数组，它应被调用以针对这些类。有关详细信息，请参阅TargetedAccessor。

items.source: Should only be invoked if canRead(EvaluationContext, Object, Object) returns true for the same arguments.
items.translation: 仅当对相同参数调用canRead(EvaluationContext, Object, Object)返回true时，才应被调用。

items.source: Should only be invoked if canWrite(EvaluationContext, Object, Object) returns true for the same arguments.
items.translation: 仅在 `canWrite(EvaluationContext, Object, Object)` 对相同参数返回 true 时调用。

items.source:
This interface places no restrictions on what constitutes an indexed
structure. Implementors are therefore free to access indexed values any way
they deem appropriate.
items.translation: 该接口对什么构成索引结构没有限制。因此，实现者可以自由地以他们认为合适的方式访问索引值。

items.source:
Determine if this index accessor is able to read a specified index on a
specified target object.
items.translation: 确定此索引访问器是否能够在指定的目标对象上读取指定的索引。

items.source:
Determine if this index accessor is able to write to a specified index on
a specified target object.
items.translation: 确定此索引访问器是否能够在指定的目标对象上向指定索引写入数据。

items.source: AccessException - if there is any problem determining whether the index can be read
items.translation: AccessException - 如果确定是否可以读取索引时出现任何问题。

items.source: AccessException - if there is any problem reading the index
items.translation: AccessException - 如果读取索引时出现任何问题。

items.source: AccessException - if there is any problem determining whether the index can be written to
items.translation: AccessException - 如果确定是否可以写入索引时出现任何问题

items.source: AccessException - if there is any problem writing to the index
items.translation: AccessException - 如果写入索引时出现任何问题

items.source: true if this index accessor is able to read the index
items.translation: true 如果此索引访问器能够读取索引。

items.source: true if this index accessor is able to write to the index
items.translation: true 如果此索引访问器能够写入索引。

items.source: newValue - the new value for the index
items.translation: newValue - 索引的新值

items.source: Jackmiking Lee, Sam Brannen
items.translation: 杰克·米金 (Jackmiking Lee), 萨姆·布拉南 (Sam Brannen)

items.source:
a TypedValue object wrapping the index value read and a type
descriptor for the value
items.translation: 一个包装了读取的索引值的 TypedValue 对象以及该值的类型描述符

items.source: Read an index from a specified target object.
items.translation: 从指定的目标对象读取索引。

items.source: Write to an index on a specified target object.
items.translation: 向指定目标对象上的索引写入数据。
